findings.summary: Independent music generation guards pending Stop/replacement/return-to-current; inherited entry generation alone does not cancel loading.
SUBMITTED diagnostics precede promise handler attachment; FAILED reporting can skip error delivery if it throws; terminal catch can itself reject. Default clock/logger failure is unobserved.
Desired resource is written at submission; a still-current request failing after inherited successor entry is logged for its old owner without stopping/retrying the successor.
Selected routes are real historical episode1/2/3 smoke routes; user's hand-review acceptance remains valid. Protected original19 includes drafts from episodes4/5 and is a different scope.
Matched Director BG/Init continuation is not gated by the inspected music-success callback. Concurrent latch correlation, recording producer path and timing remain unproven.

limits: Static review is not runtime or recording equivalence validation.
